parsed.rationale: All 15 participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on SwiftUI's `View` type spread across unrelated packages — WXUI, Wallpaper, PartyHorn, PlayerHeaderView, MusicShareKit, and app:iOS. The cluster was surfaced by a name-collision query, but the collision is on the empty-string extension name, not on any shared member shape: `fields_or_signature` is empty for every record and `structural_evidence` carries all-null slots (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor). Each extension is a local, file-scoped conformance helper for a distinct domain concept (GlassEffect compatibility, OverlaySheet, PlaybackBlendMode, WipeDownRevealModifier, AccentColorEnvironment, etc.), so the structural coincidence is purely that they all extend `View` with no surfaced shared members. No consolidation is warranted.
